review_notes: I read the whole file. I also read Mathlib/Logic/Function/OfArity.lean and the uses of FromTypes in Mathlib/Data/Fin/Tuple/Curry.lean. The only nearby competing concept is `Function.OfArity`. It is already an `abbrev` for `FromTypes (fun _ : Fin n => α) β`. Its `const`, `inhabited` and curry/uncurry are thin wrappers over the `FromTypes` versions. So that is integration, not a duplicate. The `fromTypes_*_equiv` defs are `Equiv.refl` versions of the `rfl` theorems. They are small named API and do not form a competing representation of a concept. I did not search Lean core or Batteries for a heterogeneous n-ary function type. I am not aware of one there, and the Mathlib hits turned up nothing else. I found no justified finding under this rubric.
